content: As it relates to dimensional analysis, is there code for or a proof of the Buckingham Pi Theorem?

You might be interested in #PhysLib > physical units. The associated paper https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.13142 mentions the Buckingham Pi Theorem. Unfortunately, I haven't had time to look into this myself to see how it is formulated.

Thank you Niels. I previously read through the arxiv paper (which is what alerted me to the Buckingham Pi theorem in the first place). I also started going through the numerous posts on #PhysLib > physical units. I'll keep digging.
Using my library lean-units, this should be easy to prove. i'll take a shot at it when i have time.
